target_concept: Identify the two pieces of user information required by `git config --global` and how to set them

mcq.questionText: Which of the following command sequences correctly sets both the global Git user name and email?
options: git config --global user.name "Alice" && git config --global user.email "alice@example.com"
git config --global user.name Alice && git config --global user.email "alice@example.com"
git config user.name "Alice" && git config --global user.email "alice@example.com"
git config --global user.email alice@example.com && git config --global user.name "Alice"
mcq.correctAnswer: git config --global user.name "Alice" && git config --global user.email "alice@example.com"
mcq.explanation: The correct sequence uses the --global flag for both settings and encloses the name and email values in double quotes, matching the syntax described in the evidence.
